summary: Controller token attribution completed end to end (G012 user feedback 5). The zcode model_usage mirror (zc_requests) gained the per-request token columns via additive store v3->v4 upgrade that resets the model_usage_rowid cursor so existing mirrored rows are re-read and backfilled idempotently (no double counting; v1->v4 chain and future-version refusal intact). usage_readmodel gained request_totals (model_usage request caliber: identity = session_id+logical_request_id+attempt_index dedup, cache_read subset of input, processed = input+output, turn_usage never stacked, error zero-placeholder flagged, settling rows named, NULL fields partial-summed with missing counts, never zero-filled) and rebuilt controller discovery: the root ancestor (any parent-chain depth, cycle-safe, linked roots excluded as attempt books) of anchor-linked subagent sessions, directory recorded as an alias-resolved fact and never used to guess; run attribution only on unique run evidence with explicit reasons (multi-run shared, unknown run); native_session_preview now carries controller_sessions entries (own request-caliber usage, updated stamps, child anchor evidence incl. nonces) plus a per-run controller_for_run verdict (attributed / unattributed / host_session_unbound / session_not_imported / no_controller_session / no_zcode_attempts, ids and reasons only, no top-level token numbers). Swift detail (DetailModels/DetailPresentation/RunDetailView) shows controller tokens via the shared MetricsFormat 3-digit grouping, source, updated-at and attribution basis; shared-across-runs sessions show their own cumulative total with a mandatory not-prorated label; unbound/not-imported show the reason with no numbers; the two calibers stay structurally separate. Live read-only verification against the real zcode DB + ORX state.db (scratch store under /tmp, sources untouched, stores removed afterwards) found every verdict path in real data: R003/R004/R005/R010 attributed; R007/R008 and R011/R012 shared-across-runs (current run R012's controller session: 345 requests, input 105,424,695, processed 105,625,001, 69/69 nonce-anchored children); R001/R006 host_session_unbound; R002 session_not_imported; R009 no_controller_session. De-identified aggregate record in docs/diagnostics/g012/t005-controller-token-attribution.md. No writes to ORX state.db, no mixed calibers, no scheduling/recovery/replay/usage-backfill calls.
